# 🐛 Bug Report

Thank you for helping us improve! Please use this template to report any reproducible bugs you encounter.

---

## 🐞 Describe the Bug

Please provide a clear and concise description of the issue. What is it doing that it shouldn't, or what is it not doing that it should?

---

## 👣 Steps to Reproduce

Help us replicate the bug by providing detailed, numbered steps.

1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. See error '....'

---

## ✅ Expected Behavior

Clearly describe what you expected to happen when following the steps above.

---

## 📸 Screenshots (Optional)

If possible, please add screenshots or screen recordings to visually demonstrate the bug. This can be incredibly helpful!

---

## 📝 Additional Context

Please add any other relevant information that might help us understand and resolve the bug.

---
